property_summary: Ether conservation: after any deposit via Put, the contract's own ether balance must equal the total of all credited Holder balances (each deposit credits the caller's recorded balance); the mutant keeps the ether but never credits the balance, so address(c).balance exceeds the recorded balance for any positive deposit.
change_summary: Delete the statement that adds msg.value to the caller's balance, so Put no longer increases Acc[msg.sender].balance.
